methods.name: Synergistic Fusion Network (SFNet)
methods.summary: SFNet is an encoder-decoder network designed for landslide segmentation that integrates multispectral, slope, and DEM data. It features a multi-branch feature extraction module, a channel attention module, multi-source fusion modules (MSFM) for integrating diverse data, and reverse feature refinement modules (RFRM) to enhance feature representations.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the custom code for the Synergistic Fusion Network (SFNet) is not available.
